summary: A Tottenham solicitor firm appears to lose clients to a free builder address, a template footer name and news from 2015.

findings.problem: The site appears to run on a free Wix address, though your email uses moorehouseslaw.co.uk.
findings.cost: Clients checking a solicitor's credibility trust a firm domain, and a builder address looks temporary.
findings.fix: Your own domain connected to the site.

findings.problem: The footer appears to say 2023 by Lawyer & Lawyer, which looks like a template name and not Moorehouse Solicitors.
findings.cost: A wrong name in the footer makes visitors wonder whose site they are on.
findings.fix: Your firm name and details everywhere.

findings.problem: The News and Publications items appear to be dated 01-09-2015.
findings.cost: Old news tells a client the firm may not be active, so they call another firm.

findings.problem: Only a mobile number and an email appear, with no WhatsApp, and the page title says Immigration & Visas UK Lawyers instead of your firm name.
findings.cost: Clients who want a quick message have no easy way, and searchers do not see who you are.
findings.fix: A one tap WhatsApp button and a title with your firm name.
